evidence: Film thickness was measured at a wavelength of 632.5 nm using an ellipsometer (Gaertner L116C) and the thickness of interfacial oxide layers was also measured by transmission electron microscopy (TEM). The film composition was analyzed by Auger electron spectroscopy (AES) and 2.24 MeV He2+ Rutherford backscattering spectroscopy (RBS). The chemical binding state of components in the films was determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) using Mg K radiation. Capacitance-voltage (C-V) measurement was determined using CV analyzer (Keithley 590) at a frequency of 1 MHz and current-voltage (I-V) measurement was evaluated using a semiconductor parameter analyzer (HP 4145B).
